issuer: the Registrar of Motor Vehicles; the Tanzania Revenue Authority publishes and collects the licence fee
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Tanzania Revenue Authority's motor vehicle page gives the motor vehicle driving licence fee as TZS 70,000, the licence renewable every 5 years (the driving test TZS 3,000 and the provisional licence TZS 10,000 aren't held). The Road Traffic Act (Cap. 168), read in TanzLII's copy "as at 31 July 2002" (its note says the amendments of 2010, 2011, 2012 and 2019 aren't applied), s. 25 has applications made in person to the Registrar and bars a driving licence to anyone under 18 except for a moped; its three-year term (s. 25(2)) is superseded by the five years the Revenue Authority publishes, so 5 is held. The age rests on that copy: whether a later amendment changed it wasn't read (a reading to check). Zanzibar's licences are its own and aren't held. The identity card is the ids engine's. No exchange list was read.

sources.title: Road Traffic Act, Chapter 168, legislation as at 31 July 2002 (TanzLII)
sources.said: Legislation as at 31 July 2002 ... An application for a driving licence or a learner driver's licence, except an application for renewal ... thereof, shall be made in person to the Registrar ... A driving licence shall not be issued to any person ... who is under the age of eighteen years, except in respect of a moped;
